Check out our socials to see photos and get updates: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/lisbondigitalnomads/) join our [Slack community](https://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack) to connect with others! Bring your best vibe, treat others with kindness and respect, and make an effort to greet new faces. Looking forward to meeting you! ***The Lisbon Digital Nomads Meetup Team*** PS - Join our Slack community [here](http://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack).
